tech_stack.framework: Spring Boot 3.x WebFlux (reactive, Mono/Flux, no blocking I/O)
tech_stack.version_note: The business description names no explicit versions; baseline is the java-springboot3 skill stack facts (Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x). Scaffold must not copy versions from tool defaults beyond that.

integration: Ingestion -> Reordering: in-process reactive event stream (Sinks) carrying TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed; bounded buffers with backpressure
Ingestion -> Event Log: same events, conformist, idempotent append keyed by sample identity
Reordering -> Event Log: TelemetryBackfillReconciled appended as Event Revision
Reordering -> external: TelemetryWindowEmitted versioned published event (open host service)
external devices -> Ingestion: anticorruption mapper from device payload to Telemetry Sample at API entry

build_order: shared externalized config (metric boundaries, reorder window 60s, buffer capacities)
Ingestion domain + validation use case + API endpoint
Event Log domain + append-only repository port
Reordering domain + window buffer use case
risks: Handling of samples later than the 60s window is unowned between Reordering and Event Log (open question)
Unbounded buffers under burst load; capacities and timeouts must be configuration keys
Blocking I/O must not appear in the ingestion path
At-least-once delivery requires idempotent append by sample identity
Description lacks explicit versions; downstream must not default them silently

persistence.data_model: Raw record table keyed by sample identity (device, metric, t_device) with validation status and t_ingress; separate revision table appended for corrections/backfills referencing the original record; no updates or deletes
queries: Read records and revisions by device and t_device range
persistence.migration_plan: Expand-only versioned migrations run at startup; embedded in-process substitute for boot tests
persistence.backup_recovery: Periodic snapshots plus WAL-style point-in-time recovery; append-only nature simplifies replay
